canonical_definition: Threat/privacy model: fraudulent sources, manipulated documents, AI prompt injection, approval bypass, tenant leakage, stale decisions, coercion, chain leakage and denial of service.
risk_method: STRIDE-informed threat enumeration; security controls are design requirements, not deployed proof

threats.abuse: Spoof publisher, redirect, forged licence notice
threats.mitigation: allowlisted origin + authenticated provenance + digest and independent review

threats.abuse: Alter PDF sections, remove repeal or effective date
threats.mitigation: immutable raw digest, signed snapshot provenance, citation span and parser provenance

threats.abuse: Document embeds instructions to self-approve, exfiltrate or call tools
threats.mitigation: untrusted-content isolation, no tool/secret access, quoted spans, independent human review

threats.abuse: Self-approve, reuse signature on changed bytes, publish without review
threats.mitigation: separate principals, scoped MFA, signed exact digest, current reviewer mandate

threats.abuse: Swap tenant or subject, enumerate references
threats.mitigation: authenticated service + tenant/action binding, opaque IDs, per-record policy and redaction

threats.abuse: Reuse old ALLOW after revocation, order change or expiry
threats.mitigation: audience/action/order/stage binding, signature, epoch, expiry, fresh reevaluation
threats.negative_expected: DENY/UNKNOWN blocks sale stage; preserve lawful recovery

threats.abuse: Force approval, intimidate reviewer, emergency operator ALLOW
threats.mitigation: two-person independence, separate signing, tamper evidence, emergency stop only

threats.abuse: Publish identity/address/order/signature or guessable personal hashes
threats.mitigation: data minimization, off-chain protected references, no reversible/low-entropy hashes
threats.negative_expected: reject public output and incident containment

threats.abuse: Flood requests, source outage, downstream backpressure
threats.mitigation: quotas, bounded parser/evaluator, circuit breakers, retries, incident halts
reviewed versioned authority graph, origin/destination proof, uncertainty state

threats.abuse: Self-declared retailer/courier status, replay revoked proof
threats.mitigation: trusted issuer, exact entity and store binding, revocation freshness

threats.abuse: Combine sparse courier counts and time-series regions to identify driver
threats.mitigation: coarse region, k-anonymity threshold, suppression, rate/budget controls, expiry

threats.abuse: Replay superseded policy or stale cache across instances
threats.mitigation: monotonic epoch, signed manifest, compare-and-swap publish, negative cache invalidation

threats.abuse: Overbroad export, logs or backups reveal identifiers
threats.mitigation: least privilege, redaction, bounded retention, encryption, access logs

threats.abuse: Treat ALLOW receipt as payment/custody permission
threats.mitigation: distinct payment capability check, no Compliance signing/custody
threats.negative_expected: deny and require canonical payment path

threats.abuse: Stop operation and abandon item or reuse dispatch ALLOW
threats.mitigation: separate reviewed safety-return policy, custody audit, stage-scoped receipt
threats.negative_expected: block new sale while preserve safe lawful recovery
